purpose: Refresh provider-neutral Codeberg repository facts without changing curated content.

purpose: Rank published self-hostable projects by missing or risky facts.

purpose: Separate hard publication blockers from soft review warnings.

purpose: Verify that published project icons are usable local PNG files.

purpose: Apply reviewed field-level corrections with provenance.
